shortDefinition: Automatically directing AI requests to the most appropriate model based on task type, cost, or quality needs.
fullDefinition: Model routing is a technique where an orchestration layer automatically selects which AI model to use for a given request. Simple requests may be routed to smaller, cheaper, faster models. Complex reasoning tasks may be routed to frontier models. Cost-sensitive applications use routing to balance quality and cost. Products like OpenRouter and some enterprise AI gateways implement model routing.
